text:
maria (PM): quick sync — need to lock prioritization for the observability console work across dashboards, tracing, retention, and onboarding UX. customers are asking for retention tiers + trace sampling. prefer a decision today so we can scope the PRD and RFCs.

sam (Eng): +1. propose phased launch: v1 = core dashboards + basic trace view + retention tiers (30/90) + simple onboarding flow. leave advanced trace UX for v1.5.

devon (Design): we need to surface retention impact in the UI early; also onboarding flow must handle empty-org state and low-signal tenants. I can sketch two flows by EOD.

anika (SRE): important — retention tiers affect storage/backfill and query cost. need explicit acceptance criteria for sampling + fallback when storage tier changes. also require SLOs for trace query latency (p95 < 500ms for 30d).

cj (Data): instrumentation notes: we must emit `obs_ui.view` events with `dataset` and `retention_tier` fields. also add a usage metric for trace sampling rate per org. this will feed cost telemetry.

karen (Director): what are the concrete launch criteria? customers are pressing for guarantees around retention guarantees and compliance. list please.

maria (PM): drafting acceptance criteria now — pasting quick list:
```
- Dashboards: core metric charts render for 95% of orgs within p50 200ms, p95 800ms.
- Tracing: basic span timeline, search by trace id, sampling toggle per-org.
- Retention: 30d / 90d tiers available at launch. migration tool documented.
- UX: onboarding empty-state + retention modal + billing warning when tier upgrade impacts cost.
- Observability telemetry: events emitted for view, retention change, and sampling adjustments.
- Launch gating: canary to 10% of orgs, rollback policy, and post-launch cost monitor.
```

sam (Eng): backend deps: API to set retention per-org + migration job. ETA ~3 weeks if prioritized. also need query optimizer work for traces under retention boundaries.

devon (Design): edge cases: orgs with <100 events, mixed-model workloads, and mixed cloud regions. will add in the PRD.

anika (SRE): operational acceptance checklist:
- Canary deploy + synthetic traces run against canary orgs
- Alerting for trace query latency & storage growth
- Runbook for rollback and data-consistency check

release-bot: scheduled deploy window proposal: <2026-07-12 02:00 UTC> -> canary -> grad rollout over 48h.

maria (PM): next steps: 1) sam to create RFC for retention API + migration (owner: @sam), 2) dev to add design mockups (owner: @devon), 3) cj to add telemetry schema and cost dashboard (owner: @cj), 4) anika to list SRE acceptance steps (owner: @anika). please ack if you can hit deadlines.

sam (Eng): ack — I'll spin up RFC today, link to <https://redwood.internal/prd/obs-ui-v1|PRD> when ready.

devon (Design): ack, sketching flows now.

cj (Data): ack, will add schema and estimated cost delta.

anika (SRE): ack, will add runbook items + alerts.

maria (PM): decision: go with phased v1 as above. scope locked for roadmap sprint. final PRD deadline: 5 working days. if any blocking customer requirement appears we escalate to karen. :thumbsup:

karen (Director): thanks — escalate if any compliance blockers.

maria (PM): cool — I'll consolidate notes into the PRD and ping for reviews. end of thread.
